g.text: Wiring: every connection, coloured by net (letters = breadboard lines)

g.text: Pin positions are for the DOIT 30-pin board,
counted from the USB end. Clones vary:

g.title: sht
g.text: SHT40 breakout (header: VIN 3V GND SCL SDA)

g.title: checks
g.text: • A–B ≈ 33 Ω (50 Ω = one resistor unseated, 100 Ω = two)
• Q1 E-B-C left to right: left → G, middle → E, right → D
• both LEDs: long leg towards VIN
• SHT40 lead: 3V3, GND, GPIO16, GPIO18 do not
beep to each other or to VIN
